title: A draft PR that no live session owns and no doing step names closes as stale
why: The open-PR count was 763 at 21:00 CST Nov 9; the owner wants it down to live work (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST: "the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices").
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Goal: open PRs are live work only. Test: no live (unarchived) session owns the draft PR, and no step marked doing names it. Then it closes as stale with a comment that names why; its branch stays, and it reopens on need. The first pass is a preview list for the coordinator's read before any close. Filed from coordinator 21:34 CST, corrected 21:35 CST (dropped a 7-day no-commit test as an unmeasured fixed value).
